title: Acme Platform · update, 5 November
_guide: The "update" variant: short, between weeklies, only what the last weekly did not cover. Its window starts where the last video ended. The hook is closing what the last video left pending ("in review" then, "live" now). Same rules as the weekly: impersonal, complete sentences, claims backed in evidence/claims.json.
